solution.approach: Official Answer: Option B (**120**). Number = 160; 75% of 160 = 120.

trapAlert.en: Option A (160) is the FULL number! Question specifically asks for **75%** of it (120).
trapAlert.hi: सावधान: Option A (160) पूरी संख्या (100%) है! प्रश्न ने इसका **75%** (120) पूछा है।

steps.en: Do NOT find 100%! Since $15\% = 24$ and $75\% = 5 \times 15\%$, Answer $= 5 \times 24 = \mathbf{120}$!

solution.en:
Method 1: Find 100% First: $100\% - 85\% = 15\% = 24 \implies N = 24 \times \frac{100}{15} = 160$.
`160` × $75\% = \frac{3}{4} \times 160 = \mathbf{120}$.

Method 2: Direct ×5 Scaling (15% × 5 = 75%) (3 sec): Do NOT find 100%! Since $15\% = 24$ and $75\% = 5 \times 15\%$, Answer $= 5 \times 24 = \mathbf{120}$!

question.hi: सुरेश अपनी आय का 30% पेट्रोल पर, शेष आय का $\frac{1}{4}$ घर के किराए पर और शेष भोजन पर खर्च करता है। यदि वह पेट्रोल पर ₹300 खर्च करता है, तो घर के किराए पर उसका खर्च क्या है?

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option D (**₹175**).
solution.keyConcept: Compare % Directly Without Even Finding Total Income!

optionTrick.en: Remaining $= 70\% \Rightarrow$ House Rent $= \frac{1}{4}$ of $70\% = 17.5\%$. Given $30\% = Rs.300$ (`1% = ₹10`) -> $17.5\% = \mathbf{Rs.175}$!

title.hi: विधि 1: पहले कुल आय निकालकर हल

steps.en:
1) $30\%$ of Income $= Rs.300 \Rightarrow$ Income $= Rs.1,000$.
2) Remaining after petrol $= 1,000 - 300 = Rs.700$.
3) House rent $= \frac{1}{4} \times 700 = \mathbf{Rs.175}$.

solution.en:
Method 1: Find Total Income First: 1) $30\%$ of Income $= Rs.300 \Rightarrow$ Income $= Rs.1,000$.
2) Remaining after petrol $= 1,000 - 300 = Rs.700$.
3) House rent $= \frac{1}{4} \times 700 = \mathbf{Rs.175}$.

Method 2: 1% = ₹10 Direct Chain (5 sec): $30\% = Rs.300 \Rightarrow 1\% = Rs.10$. Remaining $70\% \times \frac{1}{4} = 17.5\% \Rightarrow 17.5 \times 10 = \mathbf{Rs.175}$.
